title: feat(cloud-connection)!: refuse a managed upgrade that renames or retypes a stored field until it is declared or confirmed
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiWDNwmTd9esHVSgrxXCmHkf)_

Fixes #30884

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — a managed re-install that succeeds today is refused `409 SCHEMA_UPGRADE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` on an undeclared suspected rename or a `needs_confirm` / `destructive` type change, and a declared rename is refused `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` until #30885; the widening half is the new ledger code and the `confirmSchemaUpgrade` body key / `--confirm-upgrade` flag. Ruling record 6709061297.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here — content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx (`--confirm-upgrade` paragraph beside `--confirm-access-upgrade`), content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx (the `renamedFrom` row: such an upgrade is refused 501 until #30885); `skills/**` teaches neither flag nor `renamedFrom`, so no skill change.

> **BREAKING** — accept-set narrowing at `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` for a managed re-install. A re-install whose package upgrade plan lists an undeclared suspected rename, or a type change that is not `safe`, is now refused `409 SCHEMA_UPGRADE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` until the same call carries the finding set's token; one that declares a field rename (`renamedFrom`) is refused `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` until the runtime can carry the column (#30885).
>
> **Migration.** Declare the rename on the new field (`renamedFrom: ['<old key>']`) and rebuild, or confirm the findings as listed: `os package install <artifact> --confirm-upgrade <findingSet>` (`os deploy --confirm-upgrade <findingSet>` against a self-hosted runtime), or `"confirmSchemaUpgrade": "<findingSet>"` in the install-local body. `--dry-run` previews the plan first.
>
> **ADR-0087 disposition** (the changeset carries the one marker): not-required (no-migration-prescription) — no schema key is added, removed or re-shaped; the refusal judges two package bodies at the install door and prints its own way through.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：受管软件包重装（升级）时，在写入任何东西之前先比较已装版本和新版本。没声明的疑似改名、或会改动已存数据列的类型变化（needs_confirm / destructive），返回 409 `SCHEMA_UPGRADE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`，附每条发现和一个确认令牌；带上令牌（`--confirm-upgrade`）重发即安装，并在安装记录里留下谁在何时确认了哪一组发现。声明了 `renamedFrom` 的改名在搬列能力（#30885）落地前回 501。`safe` 类型变化、删字段、种子变化不拦。
- 为什么改：今天改名会静默变成一个新的空列，旧数据还在旧列里但看不到；改类型也是静默的。这是 Q3 「默认拒绝，需显式映射」 的落实，田騏 已对本 PR 裁定 A。
- 风险与回滚：只影响受管包的重装；首次安装、unmanaged 安装、无发现的升级行为不变。误报（真的删一个、加一个无关字段）代价是一次确认。回滚即还原本 PR；ledger 里新增的码是纯加法。
- 先看：`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 的 `schemaUpgradeVerdict`（哪些发现要确认、令牌怎么算）和 `evaluateSchemaUpgradeGate`（501 / 409 / 放行三条路）；`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` 的新码一行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-upgrade-plan.test.ts`，预期全部通过（step 2c′ 一组，含孤儿安装、记录损坏或缺失、声明改名 501 等情形）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

PR 2 of 2 on #30884 (PR 1 #30983 landed the comparison, the environment half and `dryRun`; handoff 6688284693). Under the ruling record 6709061297 (the maintainer chose 「A 全部同意（推荐）」; C1–C4 all A):

- **The ledger** (`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`): one code, `SCHEMA_UPGRADE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, under `@objectstack/cloud-connection` (C1), in that array's alphabetical order. No other `packages/spec/src/**` hunk.
- **The verdict** (`schemaUpgradeVerdict`, module-level in `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`): reads `comparePackageVersions` alone (C3), each side folded by `resolveStackCollection` as `planUpgrade` folds it. Declared renames are listed on their own; a suspected rename always needs confirming; a type change needs confirming when its category is `needs_confirm` or `destructive`, on a declared rename too (scope note 6685166393). The token is `schema-upgrade:` plus 32 hex of a SHA-256 over the findings' identities, sorted, never their sentences or row counts: the same two versions always give the same token, any change to the set gives another.
- **The gate** (`evaluateSchemaUpgradeGate`, step 2c′ after the access gate 2c, C4), managed re-install only (`conflict === 'marketplace'`), before any write:
  - a declared rename ⇒ `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, naming each `object.old → object.new`, token or not (C2); the findings a token would still owe are listed in `details.findings` beside it;
  - findings ⇒ `409 SCHEMA_UPGRADE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` with `details.findingSet`, `details.findings` (each with `kind` and a one-line `describe`), `details.confirmWith`; the message names both ways forward (declare `renamedFrom` and rebuild, or confirm with the token); a token from another set gets the stale-token sentence;
  - the matching token ⇒ installs, and the ledger entry records `schemaUpgradeConfirmation` (`findingSet`, `confirmedBy`, `confirmedAt`);
  - no finding ⇒ unchanged, `planUpgrade` never asked.
  - When the `manifest` service answers `planUpgrade`, each refused finding carries `rows` (the installed column's non-null rows) and its `describe` says so (C3); without it, or when the reading throws, the refusal is the same without counts.
- **The CLI**: `os package install --confirm-upgrade TOKEN` sends `confirmSchemaUpgrade`, and the 409 prints every finding, the `renamedFrom` way forward and the exact retry. `os deploy --confirm-upgrade TOKEN` passes it through to the self-hosted install, as `--confirm-access-upgrade` is (see Acceptance notes: a file-surface extension).

## Tests

Each under `os-verify-lock.sh` with its `VERDICT command-exit` line:

- `@objectstack/cloud-connection` `marketplace-install-local-upgrade-plan.test.ts`: 16/16, ten of them the new `step 2c′` describe — the 409 with findings, token, both ways forward and row counts, nothing written; the token installing and the ledger entry's `schemaUpgradeConfirmation`; another finding set refusing the old token; a `needs_confirm` retype refused; a declared rename refused 501 by name with and without a token, nothing written; a declared rename that also retypes `needs_confirm` still listing the type change; a `safe` retype, a removed field and a seed change installing unrefused; a no-finding re-install unchanged (`planUpgrade` never asked); no `planUpgrade` ⇒ the same refusal without `rows`; a first install never compared. **Round 2 (seat r1 6712105906, Fable r2 6714005316)** adds, across `marketplace-install-local-upgrade-plan` + `-corrupt-ledger` + `-conflict` (37/37): an orphan's retype refused 409 against the registry body, with a clean-orphan 200 control; an orphan row without a body refused 409 `installed_record_missing`, its token installing; a corrupt ledger entry refused 409 `installed_record_unreadable` (file, cause), its token installing; a corrupt entry plus a declared `renamedFrom` refused 501 with and without the record's token, nothing written; a `destructive` text→formula retype refused 409; the 501 tests with real tokens; `true` confirms nothing. `marketplace-install-local-conflict.test.ts`'s orphan upgrade is unchanged (200, assertion untouched).
- PR 1's control test now upgrades without a finding (V1 → V2 is a suspected rename, so it is refused by this PR — a stale fixture, re-judged, not weakened).
- `@objectstack/cli`: `package-install-dry-run.test.ts` gains the `--confirm-upgrade` describe (the flag reaches the body as `confirmSchemaUpgrade`, absent without it; the 409 prints each finding, the `renamedFrom` way and the exact retry, exit 1); `deploy.test.ts` gains the pass-through (retry line names `os deploy --confirm-upgrade`, the token reaches the second POST only) and the Cloud-target refusal.

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface, one extension to ratify:** `packages/cli/src/commands/deploy.ts` (+ `deploy.test.ts`) is outside the claim's list. `os deploy` runs `os package install` in-process with `retryCommand = 'os deploy'`, so without it the new refusal would print `os deploy --confirm-upgrade TOKEN`, a flag `os deploy` would reject: the self-hosted dev loop (the epic's target) would have no way through. The change mirrors `--confirm-access-upgrade` exactly. `local-manifest-source.ts` gains the `schemaUpgradeConfirmation` type on `InstalledEntry` (the ledger entry the claim names).
- **No installed body asks, never fails open.** When the gate has no installed body to compare (the ledger file will not parse, the entry carries no body, or an orphan's registry row carries none), it answers `409 SCHEMA_UPGRADE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` with one finding, `installed_record_unreadable` (file, cause) or `installed_record_missing`; that set's token installs and records `schemaUpgradeConfirmation`.
- **An orphaned install** (no ledger file, the registry row found by `findConflict` step 3) is compared against the body the registry serves. For a multi-package artifact this reads one row; the JSDoc states the limit.
- **A declared rename is 501 on every path**, including the record-unavailable one, where the renames are read from the incoming version alone (`declaredRenamesOfIncoming`); the record finding is listed beside it, with or without a token.
- **Reported, not refused**: removed fields and objects, `safe` type changes and seed changes reach the installer through `dryRun: true` (PR 1); a successful install's answer gains nothing.
- **Two refusals in a row are possible** (C4's accepted cost): an upgrade can answer the access 409 first, then the schema 409.
- **The dry run carries no schema token**: an installer reads the token off the 409, not off the plan. Adding it to the dry run would be a widening of its own.
- **The 501 names the way to install now** (drop `renamedFrom`, confirm the suspected rename) because it exists; it says the values stay in the old column.
- **Ledger position**: the code sits in `@objectstack/cloud-connection`'s array in alphabetical order (after `RESEED_SKIPPED`); its comment names `ACCESS_UPGRADE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` as its sibling.
- **Out of scope, noted**: cloud's hosted install door (sibling card 01c) reads the same 409.
